NORTHERN MICHIGAN., (WPBN/WGTU) -- Thousands of toys were collected Saturday at the kickoff of the Toys for Tots campaign in northwest Michigan. A toy drive was held Saturday at Fox Grand Traverse as a drive-through event. Last year, organizers said they distributed 26,000 toys to over 6,000 children in Grand Traverse, Benzie, Kalkaska, Leelanau and Antrim counties.

picks.title: Northern Michigan artist leaves his mark on communities, one mural at a time
picks.desc: TRAVERSE CITY - A new mural at the Traverse City Civic Center is giving people another way to connect with Northern Michigan’s history through the work of artist Nik Burkhart. Burkhart created the storytelling artwork to explore the area’s history through visual elements. The mural is part of a growing collection of public art projects he has completed since returning to Northern Michigan in 2021, after spending 12 years pursuing an art career in Chicago. Burkhart’s artistic roots in Northern Michigan go back to his college years. At 19, he received an early opportunity to bring his work into the public sphere with a mural at the Emmet County Fairgrounds.

more.title: Edmore woman killed, Crystal man injured in Montcalm County head-on crash
more.desc: MONTCALM COUNTY — A 53-year-old Edmore woman died and a 65-year-old Crystal man sustained life-threatening injuries Friday morning following a three-vehicle, head-on crash in Montcalm County, according to the Montcalm County Sheriff’s Office. Deputies responded at approximately 8:20 a.m. to East Carson City Road, also known as M-57, near South Staines Road in Bushnell Township for a report of a multi-vehicle, head-on crash. Upon arrival, deputies located three vehicles involved in the collision. A preliminary investigation indicates a 2015 Ford Fusion traveling eastbound crossed the centerline and struck a westbound 2016 Mercedes S550 head-on. A 2017 Cadillac CT6 traveling westbound behind the Mercedes subsequently struck the rear of the Mercedes.
